name: Higashi (Japan)
description: A navy field charged at the centre with the Higashi village emblem in yellow: a ring with radiating strokes above a vertical bar, like a stylised sun.
history: Municipal flag of Higashi, a village in Okinawa Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field.

features.role: Higashi village emblem — a ring with radiating strokes above a vertical bar, like a stylised sun
